result.title: VizDAGuide: Misleading Chart Question Answering in Compact Vision Language Models via DAG-Structured Supervision
result.summary: Misleading charts can lead vision-language models to conclusions that conflict with underlying data. Existing work focuses on inference-time strategies, while training-time supervision remains less explored. We present VizDAGuide, a DAG-structured supervision method for misleading-chart question answering. The method represents intermediate reasoning states and their dependencies as a directed acyclic graph, assigns supervision weights according to their roles, and serializes the graph into a unified training target for open-ended and multiple-choice QA with single-pass inference. Experiments on two benchmarks across Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 models show improvements over a content- and weight-matched Linear CoT-SFT baseline on both answer formats. Process-level evaluation shows gains in grounding and operation execution, while ablations indicate that dependency structure and weighted supervision are most effective when combined. These results support DAG-structured weighted supervision for misleading-chart question answering.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究误导性图表问答中紧凑 VLM 的训练期监督，提出 VizDAGuide：把中间推理状态及其依赖关系表示为有向无环图，按各状态的角色分配监督权重，并将图序列化为统一训练目标，使开放式与多选 QA 都能单次前向推理。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「轨迹训练、贡献分配与监督」这条线：DAG 依赖结构与加权监督可供核查逐步 credit assignment 及 grounding 是否真正被使用；但它是显式结构化 CoT 监督而非 latent 状态生成，其过程评测口径与对信息坍缩的启示尚待读原文确认。
